name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for home maintenance?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for home maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before reaching out for maintenance or repair services, document each issue clearly. Walk through your home and make a comprehensive punch list, noting locations, visible damage, and how long the issue has persisted. Take clear photos of damaged drywall, cracked tile, leaking trim, or settling doors to share during initial discussions. You should also consider whether related updates, like interior repainting or trim upgrades, make sense to bundle into the same visit. Having this organized information ready allows a general contractor like Abraham Becerra to assess the project scope accurately and plan proper materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compile a written punch list of needed repairs, take clear photos of problem areas, and note any timeline constraints before scheduling an estimate.
